environment.description: EKS pod running gRPC transfer service with pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode (pool_mode=transaction). PostgreSQL 14 with default transaction isolation level (READ COMMITTED). Pod has 40 gRPC worker threads, HPA configured with min 3 replicas. pgBouncer max_client_conn=400, default_pool_size=40. No SELECT FOR UPDATE, no advisory locks. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allows direct pod-to-pod traffic on port 50051.
